evidence_supporting_interpretation: Deviation is sustained: 100% of post-change days stayed elevated above the baseline-derived threshold.
Multiple signals agree: average signal agreement after the change point was 0.78.
Post-change temporal scores separate clearly from the baseline period.
Change point is robust: it moved at most 0 day under +/-10% threshold and stricter-persistence tests.
Sensor data is complete (no missing physiological values).
evidence_limiting_interpretation: Competing hypothesis groups remain similar in support (normalized interpretation uncertainty 0.99).
Contextual information is missing; the most valuable would be 'subjective_stress_level'.
what_would_increase_confidence: Collect 'subjective_stress_level' to reduce interpretation ambiguity between hypothesis groups.
Evidence that more clearly separates one hypothesis group from the others would lower interpretation uncertainty.
A longer observation window would further test whether the pattern persists.
disclaimer: TRACE confidence reflects the consistency and robustness of the available data and analytical interpretation. It is not diagnostic confidence, clinical certainty, or probability of disease.
